test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

A _ M P S A C _ P S A C O _ S A C P P _
solution:
• SMPA → A **S** M P S / A C **M** P S / A C O **P** S / A C P P **A**
 
• SCAN → A **S** M P S / A C **C** P S / A C O **A** S / A C P P **N**
